full_video.title: How a Waffle Iron Built Nike

reels.title: The Waffle Iron That Started Nike
reels.caption:
In 1971 Bill Bowerman poured rubber into his wife's waffle iron. It never made waffles again, but its grid became Nike's waffle sole.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: He Made Up a Company on the Spot
reels.caption:
Phil Knight walked into Onitsuka in Kobe with no company. Asked who he represented, he invented Blue Ribbon Sports.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Nike Started in a Car Trunk
reels.caption:
$500 each from Knight and Bowerman, then shoes sold from a car trunk at track meets: about 1,300 pairs in year one.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: The Nike Swoosh Cost $35
reels.caption:
Design student Carolyn Davidson charged $2 an hour. Knight didn't love it. Years later he gave her a gold swoosh ring and shares.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Nike Was Almost Called Dimension Six
reels.caption:
Knight wanted 'Dimension Six'. Nobody else did. Then Jeff Johnson said a word came to him in a dream: Nike.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: The Japanese Company That Saved Nike
reels.caption:
American banks kept saying no. Trading company Nissho Iwai kept Nike afloat, and in 1974 it won the Onitsuka case.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Everyone Said No to Air in a Shoe
reels.caption:
Aerospace engineer Frank Rudy pitched air pockets in the sole. Others turned him down. Nike said yes in 1978.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Nike Barely Makes Its Own Shoes
reels.caption:
Nike designs; contract factories, mostly in Asia, make the shoes. What it really sells is the feeling of the swoosh.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Michael Jordan Wanted Adidas
reels.caption:
In 1984 Nike bet its basketball budget on one rookie. Jordan wanted Adidas, but his mother got him into the Nike meeting.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Was Air Jordan Really Banned?
reels.caption:
The league did warn about the red-and-black shoe and Nike made a 'banned' ad. A fine every game? No solid evidence.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: The Dark Origin of Just Do It
reels.caption:
In 1988 Wieden+Kennedy wrote 'Just Do It'. Dan Wieden said he adapted it from the last words of Gary Gilmore.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: The Sweatshop Scandal That Hit Nike
reels.caption:
Low wages, punishing hours and child labour in supplier factories. In 1998 Knight admitted the damage, and Nike changed its rules.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: The Shoes That Changed Running's Rules
reels.caption:
Vaporfly shoes helped break so many records that officials wrote new rules. Then came Kaepernick and Kipchoge's 1:59:40.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: How Nike Lost the Runners
reels.caption:
A direct-to-consumer bet, rivals on the shelves Nike left, On and Hoka winning runners, and a share price down more than half.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: The Intern Who Came Back as CEO
reels.caption:
Elliott Hill joined Nike as an intern in 1988. In October 2024 he came back to run it, with a plan to win athletes back.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Nike #History #Business #Animation #HistoryReels

ig_parts.caption:
A ruined waffle iron, a coach who hated heavy shoes, a runner who invented a company on the spot, and shoes sold from a car trunk.
